entries.purpose: full-screen frost frame of the hourglass (freeze) booster: streaky cyan ice at the edges, a translucent white haze inward, thin white ice cracks, sparkles and tiny snowflakes; transparent middle
entries.screen: Level screen while the freeze runs
entries.notes: missing-3d: painted in code (value noise + random-walk cracks; no 3D model), built by m3d_make. SPEC-ui 4.2 proposed a code vignette (A) + a 120 pt crack tile (B2, the missing-svg lane's frostCracks); this one full-screen raster reproduces 065 in one texture and ALREADY CONTAINS cracks along every edge: use it ALONE, or the code vignette + frostCracks, never both. Draw it between the board and the HUD (065: the HUD and boosters stay crisp above the frost); fade in/out per SPEC-motion-audio. SELF-GRADE B: the phone's ice band is a little more saturated at the sides and its crack pattern denser in the corners. DIRECTOR R3 RULING: this overlay ships alone (frostCracks is not shipped). Draw it full-screen (.resizable, fill) between the board and the HUD while the freeze runs.

entries.purpose: the Box's counter ring: silver sphere with four stubby lugs, purple ring, navy well (the counter is live text in the well); a FIXED size (2.2 pitch across the sphere + lugs)
entries.notes: director r2: centred on the block (anchor = frame centre = block centre); the engine scales it by pitch/32 like the slab (round 1's crate grew the sphere with the block: a 10 x 9 box got a huge sphere). Every box in levels.json is >= 3 cells on each side, so the fixed size always fits. Counter text: white, purple outline #4B1F86, ~0.8 pitch.

3d-hud; director r2: 66x66 -> 80x86 (026's raised Home icon is 74 x 82 pt: round 1 was 0.7x), wider body, thicker arch / eaves / door frame / corner blocks, deeper orange (orangeHouse). Frame top-left (157, 730) pt.
